command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

BV=$(bwameth.py --version 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $2}')
echo "== a SECOND bisulfite aligner on the SAME reads =="
# bwa-meth aligns to a C->T converted copy of the reference and restores the real bases after.
cp chrS.fa bwm.fa
bwameth.py index bwm.fa > idx.log 2>&1 || { tail -15 idx.log; exit 1; }
test -s bwm.fa.bwameth.c2t || { echo "no C->T converted index -- bwameth.py index did not run"; exit 1; }
bwameth.py --reference bwm.fa reads.fq > bwm.sam 2> aln.log || { tail -15 aln.log; exit 1; }

NREC=$(awk '!/^@/{n++} END{print n+0}' bwm.sam)
NMAP=$(awk '!/^@/ && $3!="*"{n++} END{print n+0}' bwm.sam)
test "$NREC" = "30" || { echo "expected 30 records, got $NREC"; exit 1; }
test "$NMAP" = "30" || { echo "only $NMAP of 30 reads mapped"; exit 1; }

echo "== the tags each aligner writes -- this is why the comparison can only run one way =="
BWMTAGS=$(awk '!/^@/{for(i=12;i<=NF;i++) printf "%s ", substr($i,1,4); exit}' bwm.sam)
NXM=$(awk '!/^@/ && /XM:Z:/{n++} END{print n+0}' bwm.sam)
# bismark_methylation_extractor parses XM:Z:, which bwa-meth does not write -- so the caller
# cannot be swapped in the other direction. MethylDackel reads plain alignments, so it pivots.
test "$NXM" = "0" || { echo "NOTE: bwa-meth now writes XM tags ($NXM reads) -- the constraint changed"; exit 1; }

samtools sort -o bwm.bam bwm.sam 2> sort.log
samtools index bwm.bam
samtools view -c bwm.bam | awk '{print "bam_records", $1}'

{
printf 'bwa-meth -- a second bisulfite aligner on the same reads\n'
printf 'bwameth_version\t%s\n' "$BV"
printf 'c2t_index\tpresent   (assert -- bwa-meth aligns to a C->T CONVERTED reference)\n'
printf 'reads_mapped\t%s of %s   (assert all)\n' "$NMAP" "$NREC"
printf 'bwameth_tags\t%s  (no XM)\n' "$BWMTAGS"
printf 'xm_tagged_reads\t%s   (assert 0 -- bismark_methylation_extractor parses XM:Z:, so it CANNOT\n' "$NXM"
printf 'xm_tagged_reads\t     read a bwa-meth BAM; MethylDackel reads plain alignments and can read both)\n'
} | tee smoke-check-bwameth.txt
echo "BWAMETH OK"
